title: Message normalization
description: A synthetic example: trim a message, then normalize its case.

files.note: Adds lowercase normalization, and an isEmptyMessage function that no slice covers.

flows.title: Normalize one message
flows.description: A non-empty message is trimmed and converted to lowercase.
flows.tree:
normalizeMessage(message) → normalized text
├─ trim whitespace
└─ convert to lowercase

cards.scenario: A non-empty message contains uppercase letters and outer whitespace.
cards.change: Normalization now converts the trimmed message to lowercase.
